fields.title: ALD evidence floor and aging
fields.finding: Claimed sub1e-5 performance is below the stated5e-5 instrument sensitivity; oxide durability and PET transfer are unqualified.
fields.proposed_fix: Confirm detection limit, reporting bounds, long-term oxide protection and flex performance on the final carrier.

claim: Claimed sub1e-5 performance is below the stated5e-5 instrument sensitivity; oxide durability and PET transfer are unqualified. | ALD evidence floor and aging
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
